cites.quote: Implement must confirm the exact stored literals and compare against them in CO-1.

findings.text: EP-1 doctor_status/patient_status are marked status: known with example "Inactive", but Assumed says the exact stored literals are unconfirmed. Existing status columns use uppercase literals (SCHEDULED, NO_SHOW), so "Inactive" is a guess stated as known.

cites.quote: the reason travels in the URL, and that is acceptable because the reason for visit is not medical history (C12)
Logs carry method, route and error message only, never request bodies, contact details or medical

findings.text: The trade-off accepts putting the reason for visit in the URL because it is not medical history. That rests on the design's own reading: no context defines whether a free-text visit reason can hold clinical detail, and URLs appear in browser history.
